checkResults.scenario: Buyer signs in with phone number and OTP and lands on the dashboard
checkResults.verdict: Signed in: the one-time code was accepted and the dashboard loaded for the buyer.

checkResults.scenario: Create an RFQ event with two line items from the catalog
checkResults.verdict: Worked: the draft was created (event Wk5RY0RY) with both line items, serial numbers 1 and 2.

checkResults.scenario: Add a technical stage, fill it, then add the RFQ stage — the technical stage data must be retained
checkResults.verdict: Failed: after the RFQ stage was added, the technical stage came back empty — the questionnaire and evaluators entered a moment earlier were gone.

knownBug.title: Technical stage data lost when moving to RFQ stage

checkResults.scenario: Set the bidding window and publish the event
checkResults.verdict: Worked: the event is active with a 60-second bidding window.

checkResults.scenario: Invite a vendor and confirm they appear under Participants
checkResults.verdict: Worked: the vendor shows under Participants as Invited.

checkResults.scenario: Vendor signs in and places a bid on both line items
checkResults.verdict: Worked: the vendor signed in, priced both line items and the bid was submitted.

checkResults.scenario: With bid masking on, the vendor can still see their own bid after placing it
checkResults.verdict: Failed: with bid masking on, the vendor's own bid disappeared from their view as soon as it was placed.

knownBug.title: Vendor cannot see own bid when bid masking is on

checkResults.scenario: Vendor tries to bid below the minimum decrement — the bid must be refused
checkResults.message: Bid must respect the minimum decrement of ₹50
checkResults.verdict: Refused it, as it should: the app named the minimum decrement and kept the bid unsaved.

checkResults.scenario: Open MQCS after the bid is placed — the vendor's bid must be listed
checkResults.verdict: Worked: the vendor signed in, priced both line items and the bid was submitted.

checkResults.scenario: Send a counter offer — the time shown must be in the client's time zone, not IST
checkResults.verdict: Worked: the counter offer went out and the time is shown in the client's own time zone, not IST.

knownBug.title: Counter-offer time shown in IST regardless of client time zone

checkResults.scenario: Reject the vendor's bid with rebidding allowed
checkResults.verdict: Worked: the bid was rejected and the vendor was reopened for bidding.

checkResults.scenario: Award the full quantity to the L1 vendor and submit the proposal for approval
checkResults.verdict: Worked: proposal opened, 100 units awarded to the L1 vendor, sent for approval.

checkResults.scenario: Update the planner on the event — the buyer must stay signed in (no 401)
checkResults.verdict: Worked: the planner was updated and the buyer stayed signed in.

knownBug.title: Updating planner logs the buyer out with 401

checkResults.scenario: Create a purchase order from the awarded proposal using Quick Fill
checkResults.message: delivery_location: can't be blank; payment_terms: can't be blank
checkResults.verdict: Failed: Quick Fill left the required fields empty, so the PO could not be created.

knownBug.title: Cannot create PO: Quick Fill leaves required fields empty

checkResults.scenario: Create an event with malformed line items — expect a validation error, not a crash
checkResults.verdict: Worked: the draft was created (event Wk5RY0RY) with both line items, serial numbers 1 and 2.

checkResults.scenario: Convert the RFQ into a live auction
checkResults.verdict: Worked: the round is now a live auction with a 10-minute window.

checkResults.scenario: Open the vendor profile from the event's participants
checkResults.verdict: Failed: clicking the vendor's name sent the buyer to the Home page instead of the vendor's details.

knownBug.title: Vendor profile redirects to Home page

checkResults.scenario: Save an event as draft with bid masking on, reopen it later and publish
checkResults.verdict: Worked: the draft published with bid masking still on.
